text_block_list.text:
A day off with Phalaenopsis. 
With no plans set in stone, 
we ended up venturing far away.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The sea is truly wonderful. 
Merely gazing upon it brings a strange 
calm to the spirit.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
“Waves of the open sea that know the flow 
of myriad ages, 
as onward still they drift, what sights 
shall they behold?”

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—The words simply came to me. 
So I composed a verse.
choice_data_list: Your poems are always so magnificent.
Your poems are always so wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Fufu, my pupil is quite the flatterer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, inspiration has taken hold. 
Shall I grace the scenery with verses 
today, 
just as the fancy strikes me?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
What magnificent trees. 
Hmm—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
“A hundred years they stand, unwavering 
and upright; 
how deeply poignant are the layered 
memories they bear.”

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
“As evening falls and shadows depart, 
sinking into the sea, 
standing and watching, how dearly I yearn 
for the parting light.”

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It seems I have indulged a bit too much in 
wordplay today. 
Fufu—shall we make the next one our last?
choice_data_list:
Then... how about one for that stream 
flowing there?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Hmm. In that case—let me see.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
“Though powerless to swim against the 
rushing torrent, 
the river where I drift with you runs ever 
so clear.”

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —Well now. What did you think?
choice_data_list: I thought it was a beautiful poem.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't it? 
...In truth, that was not my own verse.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It is one of the poems my mother recited 
for me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—In my childhood, 
there was so much I had to master. 
Martial arts, scholarly refinement, 
etiquette—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis's Father
text_block_list.text:
When wielding a kodachi, turn your body 
firmly into a half-stance! 
Only then will your reach stand toe-to-toe 
with a long sword!

text_block_list.name: Young Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Yes, Father!

text_block_list.name: Young Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Affection, righteousness, distinction, 
order, and trust. 
Together, these are called Mencius's Five 
Cardinal Relationships!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Well done. Now then, 
can you explain the meaning of each 
virtue?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And poetry, too, was simply another 
cultural refinement. 
I had thought it was merely something to 
be mastered 
in order to study the classics.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Until that day, when Mother took me 
outside 
and recited that poem for me.

text_block_list.name: Young Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
This poem... it's so lovely, but... 
...Which poet composed it, I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's only natural that you wouldn't 
know. 
I composed it just now myself, you see.

text_block_list.name: Young Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: What?! You wrote it, Mother...?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Tell me. What meaning do you think 
there is in the act of composing poetry?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Such was the question my mother asked me 
back then... 
How would you answer it?
choice_data_list:
Um... To, uh, express what's in your 
heart...?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you hit right upon the mark. 
Mother said the very same thing.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Poetry is that which speaks of the world 
reflected in your eyes. 
A mirror that reflects your very heart.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis's Mother
text_block_list.text:
If you cultivate the spirit to compose 
poetry of your own, 
your heart will grow all the richer for 
it. 
And you will learn to see the world in all 
its richness.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis's Mother
text_block_list.text:
It is... yes. Perhaps akin to tending to 
the garden of your heart, little by 
little.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Your father may not look it, 
but he writes quite delicate poetry too, 
you know? Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...It was after that day that I began 
composing poems of my own. 
I wished to see the world in all its 
beauty, just as my parents did, 
and express it with that very same 
richness.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. I rarely speak of such things. 
Yet before you, it seems I become rather 
talkative.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me. 
It appears I have let my tale run on a 
bit.
choice_data_list: No, not at all! I want to hear more!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that is all for today. 
—After all, I believe my poetry has 
already told you 
quite enough about the kind of person I am 
now.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I shall prove it from here on 
out. 
Just who I am—with these legs of mine.
choice_data_list:
I'll be sure to keep your words in mind, 
Master.

...Would you mind if I shared a story from 
my past too?

...Would you mind if I shared a story from 
my past too?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I shall prove it from here on 
out. 
Just who I am—with these legs of mine.
choice_data_list:
I'll be sure to keep your words in mind, 
Master.

...Would you mind if I shared a story from 
my past too?

...Would you mind if I shared a story from 
my past too?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, how admirable of you. 
If it proves of any use, then I could ask 
for nothing more.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
All the more so that I may continue to be 
a worthy master to you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Of course. If you are willing, 
I would dearly love to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for embellishment. Speak 
of yourself 
with genuine sincerity, and naturally, 
it will become poetry in its own right.
